name: macOS preview build and smoke test

# This workflow can live in the public releases-only repository. Source remains
# in an authenticated draft-release asset and is checked against a reviewed hash.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      source_release:
        description: Draft release tag containing macos-source.tar.gz
        required: true
        type: string
      source_sha256:
        description: SHA-256 from the reviewed local source-receipt.json
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  # GitHub only exposes draft releases to callers with push access. The token
  # is passed only to the download step; this workflow never changes a release.
  contents: write

jobs:
  preview:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - arch: arm64
            runner: macos-15
          - arch: x64
            runner: macos-15-intel
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY: 'false'
    steps:
      - name: Fetch the reviewed draft source bundle
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          SOURCE_RELEASE: ${{ inputs.source_release }}
          SOURCE_SHA256: ${{ inputs.source_sha256 }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$SOURCE_RELEASE" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ ]]
          [[ "$SOURCE_SHA256" =~ ^[A-Fa-f0-9]{64}$ ]]
          test "$(gh release view "$SOURCE_RELEASE" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json isDraft --jq .isDraft)" = true
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/oe-mac-source" "$RUNNER_TEMP/oe-mac-download"
          gh release download "$SOURCE_RELEASE" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern macos-source.tar.gz --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/oe-mac-download"
          printf '%s  %s\n' "$SOURCE_SHA256" "$RUNNER_TEMP/oe-mac-download/macos-source.tar.gz" | shasum -a 256 -c -
          tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/oe-mac-download/macos-source.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/oe-mac-source"
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22.22.1'
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.27.3'
          cache: false
      - name: Install and run shared checks
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/oe-mac-source
        run: npm ci && npm run check && npm test
      - name: Build the native preview
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/oe-mac-source
        run: npm run dist:mac:preview -- --arch=${{ matrix.arch }}
      - name: Launch the packaged app and test local integration
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/oe-mac-source
        env:
          OE_MAC_PREVIEW_ARCH: ${{ matrix.arch }}
        run: npm run test:mac:preview
      # This repository is public. Retain diagnostics only; installers stay on
      # the temporary runner and are never uploaded or published by this job.
      - name: Retain build and test evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: macos-preview-${{ matrix.arch }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/oe-mac-source/dist/macos-preview/${{ matrix.arch }}/SHA256SUMS.txt
            ${{ runner.temp }}/oe-mac-source/dist/macos-preview/${{ matrix.arch }}/build-receipt.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/oe-mac-source/out/macos-smoke-${{ matrix.arch }}/*

# OpenEnsemble Desktop Client

The desktop client for your OpenEnsemble server, available for **Windows x64**
and **Linux x64**.

**[Download for your computer](https://openensemble.github.io/openensemble/desktop/)** ·
**[Latest release](https://github.com/openensemble/openensemble-desktop-client/releases/latest)**

The OE webpage selects the download for your operating system and also offers
both platform choices. This repository hosts installers and update metadata;
the OpenEnsemble server lives in [openensemble/openensemble](https://github.com/openensemble/openensemble).

## Install

- **Windows:** download `OpenEnsemble-Setup-<version>-x64.exe`, open it, and follow
  the installer. Launch OpenEnsemble from the Start menu or desktop shortcut.
- **Linux:** download `OpenEnsemble-<version>-x86_64.AppImage` into a folder you
  own, such as `~/Applications`. In Properties, allow the file to run as a
  program, then open it. Keep this folder writable for updates.

Choose your OE server from the network search, or enter its HTTPS address,
then sign in with your existing account. The client does not install a server.

The Windows installer is currently unsigned. Windows may show an
unknown-publisher or SmartScreen notice. The release includes SHA-256 checksums.

## Updates

The app checks for new stable releases shortly after startup and every six
hours. When prompted, save your work and choose **Update and restart**. It
downloads and verifies the release, updates in place, and reopens. Settings,
sign-in storage and local files remain in their existing locations.

Checking does not download or install updates. Closing the app without
accepting the update does not install anything. You can check immediately under
**App updates → Check for updates**.

Windows clients from version 0.2.0 already use this feed. Version 0.1.0 requires
a one-time manual installation. Linux users running from source need to switch
to the AppImage to enable updates.

[Desktop guide](https://openensemble.github.io/openensemble/guide/desktop-app/) ·
[OpenEnsemble website](https://openensemble.github.io/openensemble/)
